title: Online shopping
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What is one thing you prefer to buy online and one thing you prefer to buy in a physical shop?
How much do online reviews influence your decisions, and how much do you trust them?
Have easy returns made people more careless about what they order?
Would you pay a little more to buy from a local shop instead of a large online platform?
What would make you stop using an online store completely?
